# GEO + SEO Review

Use this workflow when reviewing or improving this ordering app/site for search visibility and discoverability.

## Goals
- Improve discoverability in AI-powered search assistants and traditional search engines where the app has public web pages.
- Preserve truthful, useful content and avoid keyword stuffing or fabricated authority signals.
- Prefer concrete technical and content improvements over speculative ranking claims.

## Review areas
1. AI citability: clear business identity, ordering information, menu/category descriptions, service details, and customer guidance.
2. Brand/entity clarity: consistent Shri Saibaba identity, contact details, service area, official links, and ordering instructions.
3. AI crawler access: inspect robots.txt for accidental blocking of legitimate search/AI crawlers on public pages.
4. llms.txt: recommend or generate only when useful; keep it factual and aligned with the actual public site.
5. Structured data: use valid Organization/LocalBusiness, Product/Menu/Offer where appropriate, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, and FAQ only when matching visible content exists.
6. Technical SEO: title, meta description, canonical, sitemap, robots.txt, HTTPS, mobile usability, performance, internal linking, and image alt text.
7. Content quality: accurate menu/product information, ordering steps, availability, freshness, and clear support/contact paths.
8. Indexation hygiene: keep authenticated, cart, checkout, admin, and private operational pages out of search where appropriate.

## Rules
- Never invent products, prices, opening hours, delivery areas, discounts, ratings, testimonials, addresses, or schema properties.
- Do not expose private/admin/customer pages to search engines.
- Do not add FAQ schema unless the matching FAQ content is visibly present.
- Do not create fake location or doorway pages.
- Keep usability, accessibility, privacy, and accurate ordering information ahead of SEO tricks.
- Explain significant SEO/GEO changes and verify they do not break ordering flows.

## Before delivery
- Check titles/descriptions on public pages are unique and relevant.
- Check canonical URLs and sitemap/robots references.
- Validate JSON-LD syntax and factual accuracy.
- Check mobile ordering flow and page speed basics.
- Check which routes should or should not be indexed.
- Summarize what changed, what was verified, and what requires owner confirmation.

Inspired by the open-source geo-seo-claude workflow from zubair-trabzada/geo-seo-claude.
